name: Kasimir Velikov
title: Dusk Elf of the Lakeside Camp
summary: A grave, soft-spoken dusk elf who lodges with the Vistani outside Vallaki, mourning a sister he means to bring back from the dead. The Tarokka can name him as the party's ally.
